_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 01 - Clear SIF Precursor (Mechanical Lifting / Dropped Object)
raw_text: While running 9-5/8 inch casing at Rig-04, the air winch line parted and the heavy elevator swung across the rig floor, narrowly missing two floormen who jumped out of the way. No injuries occurred.

expected_entities.exposure: Personnel in Line of Fire / Swing Path

_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 02 - Near Miss with No Injury (High Pressure Gas Release)
raw_text: Technician began unbolting the high pressure flange on the production manifold at EPS-02. Trapped pressurized hydrocarbon gas vented with a loud roar when the first two studs were loosened because the double-block-and-bleed valve was not fully closed.
Empty paint cans and cleaning rags left unattended near the workshop entrance walkway, creating a trip hazard for personnel entering the storeroom.

_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 04 - Direct Barrier Failure (Working at Height)
raw_text: During mast maintenance on the monkey board at 25 meters height, a derrickman unhooked his full body harness lanyard from the inertia reel to reach a grease nipple on the crown block without 100% tie-off.

_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 05 - Multiple Hazards (Hot Work + Electrical Switchgear)
raw_text: Contractor personnel was welding a pipe support bracket adjacent to an energized live circuit electrical switchgear with live high voltage cables exposed on the ground.

_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 06 - Multiple LSR Signals (Confined Space + Gas Test + Standby)
raw_text: Contractor personnel entered the crude oil storage tank compartment for sludge cleaning without gas test clearance certificate and without a dedicated standby man stationed at the manhole.

expected_entities.barrier_failure: Confined Space Control / Gas Test Omission

_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 07 - Negated Hazard (Routine Verification with No Incident)
raw_text: Routine inspection was conducted on mud pump discharge line. No gas leak occurred and no pressure buildup was observed during the shift.
Observed unsafe condition near the compressor shed area yesterday.

_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 09 - Different Wording for Same Hazard (Winch / Rigging)
raw_text: Tugger winch rope snapped during drill collar lifting, causing the swinging elevator to strike the mast ladder. Roughneck evacuated quickly.

_comment: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO 10 - Short Observation with Limited Information
raw_text: Derrickman working without 100% tie-off on monkey board.
